objective: Screen 24 preregistered (6 rule x 2 underlying x 2 execution) short-term index-ETF dip-reversion candidates against the frozen giants-sweep G1-G5 gates and a trade-level research-admission rule at T1 (15:50 ET minute-bar-proxy market-on-close) timing, reporting T0 (same-close) and T2 (next-open) as diagnostics only, plus a 2016-2026 per-calendar-year persistence table as context.

gates.g1_through_g5: reused unchanged from scripts/run_giants_sweep.py; see candidate-manifest.json contracts.validation for the exact thresholds
gates.research_admission_1x_t1_only: mean net return per trade > 0 in select and holdout; trade-level t>=2.0 over select+holdout; real mean-per-trade >= 95th pct of the random-entry placebo over select+holdout; T1 keeps >=60% of T0 gross mean per trade
gates.deflated_sharpe: reported for the best of the 24 trials
gates.multiple_comparisons: 24 candidates; every cell reported regardless of outcome; no cherry-picking
gates.persistence_table: 2016-2026 per calendar year, daily T0/T2 only, QQQ/SPY/IWM/DIA -- context, not an admission criterion
